limitations: No evidence of actual compromise or exfiltration
Authenticated privileged successful execution was not performed as a test
Public GitHub repository and past commits still publicly readable
One token-gated anon SECURITY DEFINER RPC needs phased external-caller migration
Many verify_jwt=false functions require individual custom authorization review
PW team/player information stays publicly accessible until an access-policy decision

evaluation.live_validation: Supabase deployed v10/v15 and live external GET 405 + POST 401, scoped original security-operations-proof monitor after protected main merge
evaluation.mode_note: No privileged credential provided to regression probes; source-level simulation uses fictional credentials.

root_cause: Two ACTIVE Supabase Edge Functions were deployed with verify_jwt=false and executed service-role or privileged Postgres reads before verifying a caller; one returned internal business metrics, the other raw SQL exceptions.
prevention: Never create a privileged DB client or use database credentials before server-only request authorization.
For verify_jwt=false Edge Functions, explicitly verify server-only bearer or sb_secret_ credentials before any privileged operation; deny ordinary JWT/anon/publishable keys.
Require no-store, nosniff, sanitized errors, POST-only semantics and independent 401/405 provider readback.
Reuse the original Security Operations scheduled monitor to detect future anonymous access regression; never claim main protection from unmerged PR sources.

evidence.source: Exact Supabase provider v10/v15 readback, external no-credential HTTP probes on both endpoints, 11 Node regressions and 6-site independent monitor.
